'''Paladin''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] individual who led the eco-terrorist group the [[Army of Life]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. He preached that individual should leave the ecology of [[Planet/Legends|planets]] that they visited as wild and random as possible, and he also encouraged people to carry out acts of terrorisms. However, he never spoke to live audiences and instead, his speeches were distributed over the [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]] by his followers. Paladin's followers did not know for certain what [[Species/Legends|species]] he was, but they assumed that he was a [[Human/Legends|Human]].
